definitions.explanation: The time when darkness begins to give way to light; early morning before sunrise.
Used in the pattern 〜の暁には to mean 'when (something happens)' or 'on the occasion of'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暁|あかつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まって→染まる：04254_somaru⟧いく。
examples.english: The eastern sky is being colored by dawn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暁|あかつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{暁|あかつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乾杯|かんぱい}→乾杯：00176_kanpai⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the plan is realized, let's all toast together.

notes:
{暁|あかつき} has both literal (dawn) and figurative (occasion) meanings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {暁|あかつき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: dawn sky
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暁|あかつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: when ~, on the occasion of ~
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暁|あかつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: when success is achieved

USAGE:
Sense 2 is often used in formal or literary contexts to express anticipation of a future event.

REGISTER:
Both senses are somewhat formal or literary.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{曙|あけぼの}→曙：10035_akebono⟧: dawn (more poetic)
- ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧: daybreak (more common)
- ⟦{明|あ}け{方|がた}→明け方：17595_akegata⟧: early morning
